comment: wintty.c tty_preference_update() and new_status_window(). The full options menu toggles hitpointbar, whose message repaints the status rows, and sets statuslines to the invalid #f. options.c doset() still calls preference_update("statuslines") after parseoptions() rejects the value, so new_status_window()'s tty_clear_nhwindow(WIN_STATUS) blanks both status rows, and they stay blank at the --More-- that precedes the menu's dismissal. A second pass sets statuslines to 3, so the same path rebuilds a three-row status window. Seeds, datetimes, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
